measurement: serial IL-6 and CRP time course under a defined stimulus
why_this_first: the model predicts a SHAPE; a shape is the cheapest thing to falsify and the cascade currently has one observable
resolves: whether the chain structure is right at all

measurement: randomised dose-response to an NLRP3 or IL-1b inhibitor
resolves: the mechanism attribution, which the model cannot supply
why_this_second: only a randomised dose-response can reject the one-knob-per-mechanism structure, and only after the chain shape is known

measurement: paired serial cap thickness and LDL in the same patients
resolves: whether cap thinning follows LDL as the model assumes
why_this_third: the plaque relation is asserted, not measured, and paired longitudinal imaging is the only thing that tests it

measurement: randomised cell-therapy arm against guideline therapy
resolution_required: >= 26 per arm for LVEF; an outcome endpoint for survival
cost_class: a randomised trial - the most expensive item, and the only one that can settle the efficacy claim
why_this_fourth: the largest claim in the repository rests on an uncontrolled observation; nothing cheaper can price a control arm
